sbo.name: SBO Program Governance & Documentation
sbo.subtitle: Making the SBO program durable, clear, and accountable
sbo.description: Q1 launched the SBO program with 95%+ vendor coverage across 14 accountable owners. Q2 is about making the program durable — establishing the Enterprise Software Committee, completing vendor mapping to 100%, documenting division-specific SBO processes, and defining how PIR integrates into the lifecycle.

objectives.text: Establish the Enterprise Software Committee with Dave Petersen as chair
Complete vendor-to-SBO mapping from 95% to 100% (~15 orphan systems remaining)
Document SBO processes with division-level specificity (Revenue: monthly; Finance: case-by-case; BI: twice/year)
Define and document PIR integration criteria with Fadi so SBO guidance can be finalized
Every SBO knows their budget and receives alerts when approaching or exceeding it

tasks.text: Prepare Enterprise Software Committee communications for Dave to use with C-suite
Document PIR touchpoints and clarify where TLP/SBO involvement begins (Fadi meeting)
Identify remaining ~15 orphan software systems and assign SBO owners
Dave to review SBO training draft
Record SBO training video after Dave's feedback
Alan Roper to develop budget visibility approach for SBOs
Follow up with Dave on Leadership Summit status; pivot comms if summit is canceled
Share SBO reporting snapshot with leadership (Ryan Packer)
tasks.owner: JoJo Jones, Melissa Boud, Dave Petersen

decisions.text: Committee renamed to "Enterprise Software Committee" — better reflects function than "Steering Committee"
Dave Petersen will chair the Enterprise Software Committee
Committee representation varies by division; not all SBOs will serve
95%+ of ~300 vendors mapped to 14 accountable owners confirmed as Q1 win
TLP's budget role is visibility and accountability — not promising spend reduction targets

reporting.name: Reporting & Accountability
reporting.subtitle: Establishing consistent, repeatable data collection and accountability structures
reporting.description: Reporting was a Q1 initiative that was not achieved. Q2 approach: Jessi will manually collect and track data while Zipped is being built. Goal is to establish data collection habits and accountability structures now — even before automation — and build toward SLA tracking.

objectives.text: Establish consistent manual data collection habits by mid-Q2
Define and align on the Q2 metrics that matter most
Build toward SLA tracking and the ability to identify areas for improvement
Establish accountability structures before automation exists

tasks.text: Manually collect and track technology request data throughout Q2
Align with JoJo and Dave on which Q2 metrics matter most
Continue routing tech requests through intake; send to SBOs for approval when needed
Document current manual data collection process so it can be automated in Zipped later

risks.title: Jira and Coupa data not connected

decisions.text: Q2 approach: manual data collection by Jessi while Zipped is built — do not wait for a perfect system
Reporting will not drive accountability until reliable, consistent data exists
Moving away from one giant aggregate report; focus on concrete SBO program outcomes first

zipped.name: Zipped — Workflow Automation Prototype
zipped.subtitle: Building an AI-powered intake and document collection prototype
zipped.description: The Jira rebuild was stalled by Ryan's departure. Zipped is an AI-built prototype for automation, reporting, and improved workflows. Q2 commitment: deliver a working prototype for document collection by end of Q2. If it proves valuable, it gets handed to engineering for production.

objectives.text: Deliver working prototype for document collection by end of Q2
Build basic intake process with vendor request portal
Automate workflows for security, privacy/AI, and legal review
Build transition logic into Coupa for evaluation decisions
Add timestamps for reporting and process-state tracking

tasks.text: Continue building vendor request portal (current primary focus)
Add timestamps for reporting and activity tracking
Restore business owner field in the intake form
Resolve database and hosting needs for the prototype
Explore connection between Zipped and Melissa's AI workflow
tasks.owner: Melissa Boud, JoJo Jones, Jessi Duffin

tasks.text: Add MNDA / trust-center first step before deeper document collection
Build automated security, privacy/AI, and legal workflows

decisions.text: Zipped replaces the Jira rebuild as the primary engineering initiative after Ryan's departure
Q2 commitment is document collection prototype only — not the full Zipped vision
First build focus is vendor request portal (external-facing document collection)
Prototype should capture MNDA / trust-center step before deeper document collection
If prototype proves valuable, will be handed to engineering for production development
